name: @daokimluc/x-router
description: X-Router — unified AI Gateway with Fastify backend, React dashboard, multi-provider routing, spending caps, response cache, and observability
author: Luc DK <daokimluc9xx@gmail.com>

scripts.build:gateway: cd apps/gateway && npx tsc --project tsconfig.json && cd ../.. && node -e "const{cpSync,rmSync,existsSync}=require('fs');const s='apps/gateway/dist',d='dist';if(existsSync(d))rmSync(d,{recursive:true,force:true});cpSync(s,d,{recursive:true});console.log('âœ“ Gateway dist synced')"
scripts.build:dashboard: cd apps/dashboard && npm run build && cd ../.. && node -e "const{cpSync,rmSync,existsSync}=require('fs');const s='apps/dashboard/dist',d='dashboard-dist';if(existsSync(d))rmSync(d,{recursive:true,force:true});cpSync(s,d,{recursive:true});console.log('âœ“ Dashboard dist synced')"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:dashboard && npm run build:gateway
